basisSet.description: Library basis set, or auto for the recommendation.

edited.description: GE and Philips: alternate transients are edit-ON/OFF MEGA-PRESS pairs; an LCModel .RAW is a MEGA-PRESS difference spectrum. Detected from the data (a .RAW from its $SEQPAR seq) when absent.

macromoleculeModel.description: MEGA-PRESS: co-edited fits MM09 and MM3co to 0.5 ppm (1.2-1.95 ppm excluded, as Osprey) and reports GABA, MM3co and GABA+; none is LCModel's mega-press-3 as before (GABA+ only, to 1.95 ppm). MM-suppressed basis sets always use none.

lineBroadening.description: LCModel's line-broadening prior for unedited spectra: widened (DESDT2 2, RFWBAS 80) recovers synthetic concentrations with the library's narrow-line basis sets, where LCModel's defaults (lcmodel: DESDT2 0.4, RFWBAS 10) scale 8-15 % low. MEGA-PRESS difference fits always use LCModel's values.

badAverageSd.description: Bad-average threshold in standard deviations; FID-A's default when absent.

waterScaling.description: Scale to the water reference when there is one.

eddyCurrentCorrection.description: Eddy-current correction with the water reference.

ppmStart.description: Upper end of the fit range in ppm; 4.0 (4.2 for MEGA-PRESS) when absent.

ppmEnd.description: Lower end of the fit range in ppm; 0.2 when absent (MEGA-PRESS: 0.5 with the co-edited MM model, 1.95 without).

frequencyMHz.description: Spectrometer frequency for a .RAW without one.

dwellTimeMs.description: Dwell time for a .RAW without one.

fractionGM.description: Grey matter volume fraction in the voxel, instead of segmenting a T1; give all three.

fractionWM.description: White matter volume fraction in the voxel; give all three.

fractionCSF.description: CSF volume fraction in the voxel; give all three.

metaboliteRelaxation.description: Tissue correction: also correct metabolite T1 and T2 (literature values at 3 T and 7 T).
